readings.Aries: The person who doubted you is still in your head. Evict them. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Taurus: There's a version of the life you're living that costs you less energy. Locate it. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Gemini: Your mind generates options at a rate that makes choosing feel like loss. It isn't. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Cancer: Your history is rich and present in everything you do. It is also, in some places, instructing you incorrectly. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Leo: You require appreciation the way cells require oxygen. Name this without shame. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Virgo: There's a problem you're solving with effort that could be solved with a single honest conversation. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Libra: Something you're trying to make beautiful would be better served by letting it be true. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Scorpio: You have been in the dark long enough to know it. The light is coming and you will be ready. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Sagittarius: You are better at starting than finishing. This particular thing deserves to be finished. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Capricorn: There is a version of this goal that doesn't require the sacrifice you've been making. Look for it. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Aquarius: There's loneliness in always being slightly ahead. Acknowledge it. It doesn't make you less visionary. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Pisces: The boundary between you and other people is more permeable than average. This is your gift and your difficulty. Simpler is correct here.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
